# Filing checklist

Read this before you file an issue or open a pull request, in every session, even one given a
single task. Each line is a rule ID the automatic checks report, with its one-line fix, so a
filing that follows it passes the first time. The checks, not this page, are the safety net:
a tool that never reads it still meets them. How they work is in
[the issue check and the pull request gate](issue-and-pr-checks.md).

<!-- Generated by `npm run filing-checklist` from `.github/scripts/pr-body.mjs` and `issue-policy.mjs`. Edit the fixes there, never this page. -->

## Before you file an issue

- `ISSUE-TYPE`: Give the issue exactly one type label.
- `ISSUE-AREA`: Give the issue at least one area label.
- `ISSUE-PRIORITY`: Give the issue exactly one priority label (high, medium or low).
- `ISSUE-SUMMARY`: Start with a "Problem" (or "Summary") section: a plain-language sentence or two.
- `ISSUE-CRITERIA`: Add an "Acceptance criteria" section with at least one `- [ ]` checkbox that has text.
- `ISSUE-FILES`: Fill in "Files likely touched" and "Must not touch" (write `None` when there is nothing).
- `ISSUE-MILESTONE`: Set a milestone (Backlog until planned); an epic is optional.

## Before you open a pull request

- `PR-CLOSES`: Put `Closes #N` in the description for the one issue the PR finishes; never `Part of #N`.
- `PR-LINKED`: Check the number after `Closes`, so the issue shows the PR on its timeline.
- `PR-LABELS`: The closed issue needs one type, at least one area and one priority label.
- `PR-ASSIGNED`: Assign the closed issue (assigning claims it and moves its card to In progress).
- `PR-MILESTONE`: Give the closed issue a milestone (Backlog until planned); an epic is optional.
- `PR-SECTIONS`: Fill in every section of the PR template, each with 10+ characters.
- `PR-SELF-REVIEW`: Under "Self-review" write a line for Reuse, Quality, Efficiency, Guidelines and Visual.
- `PR-KNOWLEDGE`: Change the note that describes the behavior, or write `Behavior change: none` with a reason of 20+ characters.
- `PR-E2E`: Give an `End-to-end exemption:` reason of 20+ characters, or write `none` or `run`.
